name: Jamaican Country Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Cumberbatch, Keren. 2012. Sociolinguistic sketch of Konchri Sain. In U. Zeshan & C. de Vos (eds.), Sign Languages in Village Communities: Anthropological and Linguistic Insights, 387-388. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton / Nijmegen: Ishara Press. doi 10.1515/9781614511496.387 (open access via OAPEN 20.500.12657/25618)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Nothing. Two-page sociolinguistic sketch (origin in Top Hill, St Elizabeth; language shift to JSL/ASL/Signed English; endangerment). No phonology, prosody or stress content.

sources.citation: Adone, Dany, Anastasia Bauer, Keren Cumberbatch & Elaine L. Maypilama. 2012. Colour signs in two indigenous sign languages. In U. Zeshan & C. de Vos (eds.), Sign Languages in Village Communities, 53-86. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton. doi 10.1515/9781614511496.53 (same OA volume)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Nothing on stress/prosody; lexical study of colour terms in Yolngu SL and Konchri Sain (mentions mouthings of English/Patwa colour words only).

sources.citation: A Bibliography of Sign Languages, 2008-2017 (Brill, 2018; OAPEN 20.500.12657/37810) -- checked index for Konchri Sain
sources.note: Index lists only entry 845 (Adone et al. 2012 colour signs) under Konchri Sain; no phonology/prosody work on the language is recorded for 2008-2017.
